mapper.select: SELECT FROM ddc_si_resource WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

mapper.update: UPDATE ddc_si_resource SET display_name = #{et.displayName}, description = #{et.description}, tags_json = #{et.tagsJson}, lifecycle_status = #{et.lifecycleStatus}, spec_json = #{et.specJson}, content_sha256 = #{et.contentSha256}, last_version_no = #{et.lastVersionNo}, current_version_id = #{et.currentVersionId}, published_time = #{et.publishedTime}, version = version + 1, update_user_id = #{et.updateUserId}, update_time = #{et.updateTime} WHERE tenant_id = #{et.tenantId} AND id = #{et.id} AND version = #{et.version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
